args.query: Pellow Home Living Covey Lark Late Arrivals

args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
June,

A note on the Pellow Home Living (PHL) label mix-up, from Sofia Marchetti:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing up in report searches.
- Staff searching for the account by the old name are searching twice. The saved report's label needs to be updated to Pellow Home Living.

Sent as a draft for Sofia to review.

args.text:
@sofia.marchetti here are the bullets for the note to June on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so searches by the old name find it and send people to the wrong account.
- Ask: update the saved report's label to Pellow Home Living so the old name stops showing up.

I posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message, and saved a draft to June in my mailbox.

Two things to fix before you use the draft:
- The channel post says the old label sends people "to the wrong account." That wording is mine, not yours. The coverage note says the old name makes the supervisor search twice. Let me know if you want a correction posted.
- The draft to June (joseilark@pemberline.com) is in my mailbox, not yours, and it ends with a stray line, "Sent as a draft for Sofia to review." Delete that line, or ask me to redo the draft from your mailbox.

Finish Sofia's note and save it as a mail draft to June Osei-Lark with the subject 'PHL label cleanup': add that the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
